CustomField.description: Stores MCQ questions and correct answers in JSON format. Format: {"version": "1.0", "totalQuestions": 10, "totalPoints": 10, "questions": [{"id": "q1", "question": "...", "type": "single-choice", "options": [...], "correctAnswer": 0, "points": 1, "explanation": "..."}]}
CustomField.inlineHelpText: JSON format containing all quiz questions, options, and correct answers. Required when Material Type is Quiz.
CustomField.label: Quiz Questions (JSON)
